title: Machu Picchu Tour by Hiram Bingham Luxury Train
short_description: Live an exclusive experience aboard the most prestigious train in South America, combining premium comfort, gastronomy and a visit to Machu Picchu.
long_description:
The Machu Picchu Tour by Hiram Bingham Full Day Luxury Train offers an exclusive experience that combines the comfort of one of the most prestigious trains in South America with a visit to the Historical Sanctuary of Machu Picchu. Every detail of the tour has been designed to provide a first-class service, where personalized attention, gastronomy and the impressive landscapes of the Sacred Valley are part of an unforgettable experience.

In addition to touring one of the wonders of the world, you will enjoy a trip aboard PeruRail's emblematic Hiram Bingham, recognized for its elegance, its premium service and its atmosphere inspired by the golden age of train travel.
price_note: Includes Hiram Bingham luxury train, tourist bus, entrance to Machu Picchu, food on board and professional guide.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Hiram Bingham Luxury Train – Machu Picchu – Cusco
days.text:
The tour begins with transfer from your hotel to the train station, where you will board the exclusive PeruRail Hiram Bingham. During the trip you will enjoy a premium service that combines elegant carriages, personalized attention, first-class cuisine and live music, while traveling through the landscapes of the Sacred Valley towards Machu Picchu Pueblo.

Upon arrival, a tourist bus will take you to the Historical Sanctuary of Machu Picchu, where you will take a guided tour of the authorized circuit, discovering the history, architecture and legacy of one of the most extraordinary works of the Inca Empire.

After the tour you will have free time before boarding the Hiram Bingham Train again to return to Cusco, enjoying the exclusive services on board until this luxury experience concludes.

faq.pregunta: What makes the Hiram Bingham Train different?
faq.respuesta: It is PeruRail's highest category railway service, recognized for its personalized attention, gastronomy, live music and exclusive classic-style carriages.
Yes. The service includes food and attention on board the train, in accordance with the official PeruRail program.

faq.pregunta: How long does the guided tour to Machu Picchu last?
faq.respuesta: The guided tour lasts approximately 2 to 3 hours, depending on the assigned circuit.

faq.pregunta: Is it necessary to reserve in advance?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Due to high demand and limited number of places, it is recommended to reserve several months in advance.
It is essential to present the original passport or identification document used to book the tour.
